item.title: When Two Tracers Disagree: An Investigation of Multimodal Fusion for Clinical PET/CT Segmentation
item.description:
中文标题：当两种示踪剂不一致时：临床PET/CT分割中多模态融合的研究

作者：Jack A. Johnson, Bart{\l}omiej W. Papie\.z

Abstract: PSMA and FDG PET/CT visualise complementary biological information in prostate cancer. Combining both tracers could capture heterogeneous tumour phenotypes that may be missed by either alone, yet there is no consensus on effective deep learning architectures for fusing these modalities. We evaluated multimodal image-fusion strategies for automatic whole-body PET/CT lesion segmentation to estimate total tumour burden. Using the public DEEP-PSMA Challenge dataset, we trained tracer-specific 3D nnU-Net baselines and compared (i) early fusion with a single encoder and one decoder (OEOD) or two decoders (OETD), and (ii) intermediate fusion via a dual-encoder cross-attention U-Net (DECA-UNet). Tracer-specific baselines performed strongly (PSMA Dice = 0.93; FDG = 0.81). Fusion yielded mixed results: OEOD produced a combined Dice of 0.90 (on an easier, non-tracer-specific task), whilst the tracer-specific fusion models reached PSMA/FDG = 0.69/0.64 (OETD) and 0.76/0.57 (DECA-UNet). Whilst fusion often provided reasonable PSMA segmentation, FDG performance degraded and no strategy consistently exceeded the single-tracer baselines. Under the evaluated setting, tracer-specific models remain the stronger baseline; clinically useful gains from multimodal fusion will likely require architectures that better preserve tracer specific representations. Our code is available at: https://github.com/JackJ3636/DEEP_PSMA_code

中文摘要：该研究评估了PSMA和FDG PET/CT多模态融合策略用于全身病变分割。基于DEEP-PSMA数据集，训练了示踪剂特异性3D nnU-Net基线，并比较了早期融合（单/双解码器）和基于双编码器交叉注意力的中间融合（DECA-UNet）。结果显示，单示踪剂基线性能强劲（PSMA Dice=0.93, FDG=0.81），而融合模型结果不一，FDG性能普遍下降，没有策略能持续超过单示踪剂基线。

研究启发（模型推断）：研究表明，在多模态融合中，简单融合可能损害特定模态的性能，架构设计需更好地保留各模态的特有表征。这一发现对遥感中异源数据（如光学与SAR）的融合策略选择具有直接参考意义。

相关度：80/100 论文系统比较了PSMA和FDG PET/CT多模态融合策略在病变分割中的表现，发现融合并未一致优于单示踪剂模型。这一‘负面’结果对多源遥感数据融合研究具有重要警示意义，提示需谨慎设计融合架构以保留各模态特有表征。

item.title: Multi-Agent Off-Policy Deep Reinforcement Learning for Smart Campus Coverage
item.description:
中文标题：面向智慧校园覆盖的多智能体离策略深度强化学习

作者：Omar Rady, Mohamed Ayman, Ali Arafa, Mohamed Shalma

Abstract: Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) has recently gained a great attention due to its real-time adaptation and effectiveness in complex optimization problems. This paper investigates the optimal deployment of millimeter-wave (mmWave) base stations (BSs) in a realistic, non-convex campus topology. The optimization problem is NP-hard, due to the non-convex, non-smooth nature of the max-min fairness objective. To overcome these constraints, we formulate the BS placement as a Markov Decision Process (MDP) and systematically benchmark four DRL schemes: a discrete single-agent Deep Q-Network (DQN), a spatially partitioned Multi-Agent DQN, a continuous single-agent Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (DDPG), and a geographically partitioned multi-agent DDPG framework. Numerical evaluations reveal that the multi-agent DDPG approach substantially outperforms single-agent in dense scenarios. Additionally full coverage is achieved, and a fairness Jain's index of 0.94 is obtained. Finally, the multi-agent demonstrates highly efficient computational convergence of dense scenarios with $400$ users.

中文摘要：该研究将毫米波基站部署问题建模为马尔可夫决策过程，并系统比较了四种深度强化学习方案，包括离散/连续动作空间的单智能体与多智能体DQN和DDPG。数值评估表明，在密集用户场景下，多智能体DDPG方法性能显著优于单智能体，实现了全覆盖，公平性Jain指数达到0.94，且计算收敛效率高。

研究启发（模型推断）：该研究表明，在具有空间异质性和复杂约束的部署问题中，采用地理分区策略的多智能体强化学习框架能更高效地逼近最优解，为城市基础设施的智能规划提供了新思路。

中文标题：面向智慧校园覆盖的多智能体离策略深度强化学习

作者：Omar Rady, Mohamed Ayman, Ali Arafa, Mohamed Shalma

Abstract: Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) has recently gained a great attention due to its real-time adaptation and effectiveness in complex optimization problems. This paper investigates the optimal deployment of millimeter-wave (mmWave) base stations (BSs) in a realistic, non-convex campus topology. The optimization problem is NP-hard, due to the non-convex, non-smooth nature of the max-min fairness objective. To overcome these constraints, we formulate the BS placement as a Markov Decision Process (MDP) and systematically benchmark four DRL schemes: a discrete single-agent Deep Q-Network (DQN), a spatially partitioned Multi-Agent DQN, a continuous single-agent Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (DDPG), and a geographically partitioned multi-agent DDPG framework. Numerical evaluations reveal that the multi-agent DDPG approach substantially outperforms single-agent in dense scenarios. Additionally full coverage is achieved, and a fairness Jain's index of 0.94 is obtained. Finally, the multi-agent demonstrates highly efficient computational convergence of dense scenarios with $400$ users.

item.title: USR-Drive: Unified Driving Scene Representation via Joint Denoising of 3D Gaussians and Boxes
item.description:
中文标题：USR-Drive：通过3D高斯与边界框联合去噪实现统一驾驶场景表示

作者：Li-Heng Chen, Haokai Pang, Chengye Su, Jiarun Liu, Qifeng Chen, Ziqian Ni, Jianxin Huang, Shi-Sheng Huang, Hongbo Fu, Sheng Yang

Abstract: Spatial representation learning for autonomous driving aims to map raw visual signals into structured 3D scene representations, where object-centric bounding boxes and rendering-oriented 3D primitives (\eg, 3D Gaussians) serve as two distinct yet highly complementary levels for scene understanding. Existing methods typically treat dynamic reconstruction and instance-level perception as separate tasks, despite their shared goal of estimating the underlying 3D world state. As a result, dynamic reconstruction is under-constrained while 3D detection lacks geometric grounding. To address this gap, we propose USR-Drive, a unified conditional generative framework that, given only posed multi-view driving videos, jointly recovers dense dynamic geometry and instance-level object layouts within a shared scene representation. Specifically, USR-Drive represents dense Gaussian primitives and sparse 3D bounding boxes as two aligned latent token streams and jointly denoises them with a unified multi-modal diffusion Transformer. Unlike prior paradigms that use boxes as external conditions or predict them with detached modules, USR-Drive treats them as mutually constrained state variables with a Unified Positional Encoding (UPE) that aligns heterogeneous tokens within a shared metric spatiotemporal coordinate. Via such unified representation and generative framework, the two modalities reinforce each other: geometry supplies dense metric evidence for box prediction, while boxes provide instance-level structural priors that help preserve spatial consistency and reduce ambiguity in sequential 3D geometric representation. Our approach successfully delivers state-of-the-art results for both dynamic reconstruction and 3D detection on the nuScenes and VKitti datasets.

中文摘要：该研究提出了USR-Drive框架，将稠密的3D高斯原语和稀疏的3D边界框表示为两个对齐的潜在token流，并通过统一的多模态扩散Transformer进行联合去噪。该框架通过统一位置编码对齐异构token，使几何重建和框预测相互增强，在nuScenes和VKitti数据集上实现了动态重建和3D检测的最优性能。

研究启发（模型推断）：该研究证明了将连续几何表示与离散语义表示置于同一生成式框架下联合优化，能够有效解决动态重建约束不足和检测缺乏几何基础的问题，为统一场景理解提供了新范式。

相关度：80/100 该研究提出了一种统一的驾驶场景表示学习框架，通过联合去噪3D高斯和3D边界框，将动态重建与实例级感知任务统一起来。其多模态扩散Transformer和统一位置编码的设计，对于多源数据融合和地理空间智能中的场景理解具有重要参考价值。

item.title: SED-FOD: Scattering-Aware Expert Decomposition for Few-Shot Cross-Sensor SAR Object Detection
item.description:
中文标题：SED-FOD：用于少样本跨传感器SAR目标检测的散射感知专家分解

作者：Shu Yang, Zhen Chen, Zhiyu Jiang, Yanlei Li, and Xingdong Liang

Abstract: Synthetic aperture radar (SAR) object detection is an important part of remote sensing interpretation. However, because of variations in frequency band, resolution, background clutter, and target scattering responses, the performance of existing detectors often degrades when training and testing data are acquired from different SAR domains. Although domain adaptation methods offer a promising paradigm for solving this problem, most of them mainly pursue domain-invariant feature alignment and suppress sensor-dependent scattering characteristics that are useful for object detection. This problem becomes more challenging in few-shot scenarios, where only a few fully annotated target-domain SAR images are available. To address this issue, we propose a scattering-aware shared-specific feature decomposition framework for few-shot SAR domain adaptation object detection. We decompose detection features into a shared path and several soft-gated scattering-specific expert paths. The shared path learns transferable object structural information and is used for asymmetric domain alignment, while the scattering-specific experts adaptively compensate heterogeneous SAR responses. In addition, routing-domain auxiliary loss is introduced to encourage specific experts to capture sensor-dependent routing preferences, and an expert balancing loss is used to prevent routing collapse. Extensive experiments on four bidirectional heterogeneous SAR detection tasks between FARAD-X/FARAD-Ka and MiniSAR under different few-shot settings have been conducted and experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method achieves superior performance in both forward and reverse adaptation directions.

中文摘要：提出一种散射感知的共享-特定特征分解框架，用于少样本SAR域适应目标检测。通过共享路径学习可迁移的物体结构信息，并利用软门控的散射特定专家路径补偿异构SAR响应，在多个双向异构SAR检测任务上取得了优越性能。

研究启发（模型推断）：将传感器特定的散射特征与域不变的结构特征分离，是提升跨传感器SAR目标检测性能的有效策略，为多源遥感数据融合和目标识别提供了新思路。

相关度：95/100 论文针对跨传感器SAR目标检测中的少样本域适应问题，提出散射感知的共享-特定特征分解框架，与遥感变化检测和多源数据融合研究方向高度相关，对提升遥感目标检测的泛化能力有重要价值。

item.title: A Critical Synthesis of Uncertainty Quantification and Foundation Models for Semantic Segmentation
item.description:
中文标题：语义分割中不确定性量化与基础模型的批判性综合

作者：Steven Landgraf, Joceline Hinz, Markus Ulrich

Abstract: Foundation models are increasingly breaking what seemed to be impossible not long ago by enabling unprecedented accuracy and cross-domain generalization. Yet their lack of interpretability, tendency to be overconfident, and sensitivity to real-world domain shifts pose critical challenges for safety- and mission-critical applications. Uncertainty quantification (UQ) offers a principled way to address these issues, but its integration into segmentation foundation models has yet to be explored. In this paper we present the first systematic evaluation of UQ methods applied to a foundation model for semantic segmentation. We fine-tune a lightweight DPT decoder on top of the pretrained SAM2 encoder to establish a simple yet competitive baseline and benchmark four representative UQ approaches - Monte Carlo Dropout, Deep Sub-Ensemble, Test-Time Augmentation, and Evidential Deep Learning - across Cityscapes, NYUv2, and two challenging out-of-domain settings. Our analysis compares segmentation accuracy, calibration, uncertainty quality, and inference time, revealing clear trade-offs between predictive performance, reliability, and computational cost. These results highlight both the promise and the current limitations of uncertainty-aware foundation models, pointing to the need for future work that jointly optimizes accuracy, robustness, and efficiency for real-world deployment.

中文摘要：基础模型在语义分割中展现出高精度和跨域泛化能力，但存在过度自信和域偏移敏感问题。本文首次系统评估了应用于分割基础模型（SAM2编码器+DPT解码器）的四种不确定性量化方法（MC Dropout、Deep Sub-Ensemble、TTA、Evidential Deep Learning），在Cityscapes、NYUv2及两个域外数据集上比较了精度、校准、不确定性质量和推理时间，揭示了预测性能、可靠性与计算成本之间的权衡。

研究启发（模型推断）：研究结果强调了不确定性感知基础模型的潜力与局限，指出未来需联合优化精度、鲁棒性和效率，这对于将分割模型部署于遥感等安全关键领域至关重要。

相关度：85/100 论文系统评估了基础模型在语义分割中的不确定性量化方法，直接关联遥感变化检测中对预测可靠性和泛化能力的需求。其关于校准、不确定性质量和计算成本的权衡分析，对构建安全、可信的地理空间智能系统具有重要参考价值。

item.title: Scalable Geospatial Machine Learning for Power-Line Asset Risk: Integrating Remote Sensing for Lightning and Vegetation Risk Modelling
item.description:
中文标题：可扩展的地理空间机器学习用于电力线路资产风险：集成遥感的闪电与植被风险建模

作者：Artur Sokolovsky, Bhavik Merai, Moe Jafari, and Muen Chen

Abstract: Electric power networks are increasingly exposed to weather-sensitive failure mechanisms that require asset-level, spatially explicit risk modelling for effective intervention planning. This study contributes a modular, robust, and explainable probability-of-failure (PoF) modelling framework for utility asset management. The central contribution is an asset-level architecture that can be scaled to new environmental data sources and additional PoF types without reworking the underlying pipeline. This is particularly relevant for industry settings, where risk models must remain operationally maintainable while adapting to changing data availability, asset-management priorities, and climate-driven hazard conditions. We demonstrate the framework for vegetation-related and lightning-related failure modes using a harmonised geospatial machine-learning pipeline. The implementation integrates multi-source predictors, including topography (SRTM), vegetation condition (MODIS Normalised Difference Vegetation Index - NDVI), lightning climatology (LIS VHRMC), OpenStreetMap-derived proximity features, and utility operational records. The resulting architecture is computationally efficient, operationally extensible, and suitable for utility-scale deployment. It provides actionable asset-level risk stratification for inspection prioritisation, vegetation management, asset hardening, and resilience planning, supporting earlier intervention and more climate-resilient network operations.

中文摘要：该研究提出了一个模块化、稳健且可解释的资产级故障概率（PoF）建模框架，用于电力设施管理。框架可扩展至新的环境数据源和故障类型，无需重构底层流程。作者集成了地形（SRTM）、植被状况（MODIS NDVI）、闪电气候学（LIS VHRMC）、OSM邻近特征和运营记录，针对植被和闪电相关故障模式进行了演示，实现了计算高效、可操作、适合公用事业规模部署的资产级风险分层。

研究启发（模型推断）：该工作展示了如何通过模块化架构将多源遥感数据无缝集成到运营风险管理中，其‘可扩展性’和‘可解释性’设计原则，为城市更新中类似的基础设施韧性评估提供了范本。

相关度：95/100 论文构建了模块化、可扩展的资产级电力故障概率建模框架，集成了SRTM、MODIS NDVI、LIS闪电数据、OSM等多源遥感与地理空间数据。这与研究兴趣中的多源数据融合与地理空间智能高度契合，其框架设计对城市基础设施风险评估具有直接应用价值。

item.title: A Locally Deployable Tool-Grounded LLM Multi-agent Framework for Automating Methane Emission Analysis and Reporting
item.description:
中文标题：本地可部署的工具型LLM多智能体框架，用于自动化甲烷排放分析与报告

作者：Yang Yan, Zifan Zhou, Xuan Wang, Erum Hassan, Bilguunzaya Mijiddorj, Jie Cao, Bin Li, and Binbin Weng

Abstract: Methane field monitoring requires the integration of sampling design, meteorological interpretation, sensor processing, plume analysis, visualization, and reporting, but these steps are often distributed across separate expert-driven workflows. We developed a locally deployable, tool-grounded large language model (LLM) multi-agent framework for our low-cost methane sensing and field-monitoring campaigns. The framework uses LLM agents as workflow coordinators that link field measurements, meteorological data, deterministic sensor-processing routines, Gaussian plume inversion, and report generation, rather than directly estimating methane concentrations or emissions. Extensive field deployments across diverse real-world environments (e.g., wastewater treatment facilities, landfills, and oil and gas sites) demonstrate that our framework can achieve 92.0\% accuracy in workflow routing and parameter extraction, 85.0\% success in emission-rate estimation and plume prediction, and 95.0\% success in generating editable reports under practical operating conditions. Compared with manual and general-purpose LLM-assisted workflows, it reduced workflow time from hours-level to minutes-level, lowered manual coordination and prompt-engineering requirements, and retained traceable plume-based outputs. In addition, most processing can be performed locally, reducing exposure of sensitive facility and field data to cloud services. These results indicate that tool-grounded LLM coordination can reduce the time, labor, usability, and data-security barriers of methane field monitoring.

中文摘要：开发了一个本地可部署的工具型LLM多智能体框架，作为工作流协调器，连接现场测量、气象数据、传感器处理、高斯羽流反演和报告生成。在多种真实环境部署中，实现了92%的工作流路由准确率和85%的排放率估算成功率，并将工作流时间从小时级缩短至分钟级。

研究启发（模型推断）：工具型LLM多智能体框架能有效整合多源数据和专业处理流程，实现复杂分析任务的自动化，并支持本地化部署以保障数据安全，对城市更新中的多源数据融合和智能决策支持系统有重要参考价值。

相关度：85/100 论文提出一个本地化部署的工具型LLM多智能体框架，用于自动化甲烷排放分析和报告，与LLM和多智能体研究方向高度契合，其工作流协调和自动化报告生成思路对城市更新中的数据分析和报告自动化有借鉴意义。

item.title: Evaluating and improving crop-yield forecasting methods during extreme drought
item.description:
中文标题：极端干旱期间作物产量预测方法的评估与改进

作者：Shrey Gupta, Yi Ming, George Mohler

Abstract: The impact of climate variability on food production has led to the creation of various forecasting models that uses machine learning (ML), numerical weather predictors (NWP) or a hybrid of ML-NWP models to identify structural and physical relationships between meteorological drivers and crop growth, in order to predict crop yield. Droughts, for example the 2012 Midwestern US (Corn Belt) drought, are extreme events that affect crop production and test the limits of these forecasting models. Using 16 meteorological drivers as predictors, we compare ML (non-deep learning) and deep learning forecasting models to predict the county-level corn yield for the extreme drought year, 2012. This forecasting problem is characterized by a dissimilarity between the feature distributions of the training and test data, where the meteorological conditions of the extreme drought year fall outside the range of historically observed values. Additionally, the dataset consists of spatial and temporal irregularities where counties with missing yields introduce spatial sparsity and the use of only a subset of daily values per year introduce temporal sparsity. To overcome this, we use sample weighting and feature selection as modifications to improve our forecasting models. These modifications lead to an improvement for ML models; however, the deep learning model VITA shows little to no improvement. While VITA outperforms the ML models with or without modifications, our current study sheds light on the effect of dissimilarity between train and test feature distributions on forecasting models, compares deep learning versus non-deep learning models, and introduces modifications that are effective for non-deep learning models.

中文摘要：本研究比较了机器学习（非深度学习）和深度学习模型在预测极端干旱年（2012年美国中西部）县级玉米产量时的表现。研究发现，训练和测试数据特征分布的不相似性对模型构成挑战。通过样本加权和特征选择等修改，机器学习模型的性能得到提升，但深度学习模型VITA改进甚微。尽管如此，VITA在有无修改的情况下均优于机器学习模型。

研究启发（模型推断）：在极端事件预测中，训练与测试数据分布的不相似性是影响模型性能的关键因素，针对非深度学习模型的修改（如样本加权）可能有效，但深度学习模型对此类修改的响应不同。

相关度：70/100 该研究评估和改进了极端干旱条件下的作物产量预测模型，涉及机器学习、时空数据和气候驱动因素，与农业遥感和环境预测相关，但非城市更新核心。

item.title: A Theoretical Framework for Parallel Lifelong MAPF Using Group Decentralized Planning
item.description:
中文标题：基于分组去中心化规划的多智能体终身路径规划理论框架

作者：Alex DeWeese, Jiaoyang Li, Guannan Qu

Abstract: In the Lifelong Multi-Agent Path Finding (L-MAPF) problem, agents must repeatedly move from one destination to another while avoiding obstacles and inter-agent collisions. Widely regarded as one of the highest-performing solutions to this problem is the Rolling-Horizon Collision Resolution (RHCR) framework. However, commensurate with its quality solutions, it incurs a computational cost that limits its applicability to even modest agent counts. In this paper, leveraging theoretical methods from the Locally Interdependent Multi-Agent MDP literature, we first theoretically prove the near-optimality of RHCR in a discounted MDP formulation of the L-MAPF problem. Then, we leverage these results to naturally motivate an extended framework called Group Decentralized RHCR (GD-RHCR) which incorporates a group decentralized structure that partitions agents based on a transitive communication scheme and plans for each partition of agents in parallel. We show that both RHCR and GD-RHCR achieve similar exponentially close to optimal guarantees, establishing a theoretical duality between the time based restrictions performed by vanilla RHCR and the additional space based partitioning performed by GD-RHCR. Lastly, we show that across varying maps, GD-RHCR is able to attain high throughput that scales into higher agent counts while maintaining a significantly lower per plan cost.

中文摘要：本文针对L-MAPF问题，从理论上证明了滚动时域碰撞消解（RHCR）框架在折扣MDP下的近最优性，并据此提出分组去中心化RHCR（GD-RHCR）框架，通过传递通信方案对智能体进行分组并行规划。实验表明，GD-RHCR在保持近最优保证的同时，显著降低了规划成本并支持更高智能体数量。

研究启发（模型推断）：时间限制与空间分组在理论上具有对偶性，这为大规模多智能体路径规划提供了新的理论视角，可应用于城市交通流模拟与优化。

相关度：75/100 该论文研究终身多智能体路径规划（L-MAPF）问题，提出分组去中心化规划框架，与多智能体系统、交通流控制等GIS相关研究方向高度契合。

item.title: MoRAX: Mobility-based Representation Augmentation for Geospatial Foundation Models
item.description:
中文标题：MoRAX：基于移动性的地理空间基础模型表示增强

作者：Ya Wen, Jixuan Cai, Yulun Zhou, Alec Kirkley

Abstract: Geospatial Foundation Models (GFMs) are emerging as a powerful paradigm for learning semantically rich and geographically consistent visual and physical representations. However, their reliance on Earth-observation (EO) data leaves information about human activity largely underrepresented. Human mobility data reveals the functional and relational structure between regions that is missing from EO data, but is often limited only to the city where it is observed, making it challenging to use for transferable urban representation learning. We introduce MoRAX, a lightweight framework for augmenting geospatial embeddings with functional structure derived from human mobility. MoRAX preserves the coverage and consistency of a GFM while providing information about the functional connectivity among urban regions, permitting zero-shot deployment in unseen cities with or without available mobility data. Across four target cities spanning two countries, the MoRAX teacher model, which observes mobility, consistently outperforms GFMs and strong urban representation baselines in eight socioeconomic and environmental prediction tasks. Meanwhile, the student model, which never takes mobility data as input, approaches the teacher in performance on most tasks. Transfer results across countries further demonstrate that modulation conditioned on mobility flows provides a general mechanism for grounding geospatial foundations in the human dimension of cities.

中文摘要：MoRAX是一个轻量级框架，通过人类移动性数据增强地理空间嵌入，以补充地球观测数据中缺失的人类活动功能结构信息。该框架在保留GFM覆盖范围和一致性的同时，提供城市区域间的功能连接信息，支持在未见过的城市中进行零样本部署。在四个目标城市的八项社会经济和环境预测任务中，观察移动性的教师模型持续优于GFM和强基线，而学生模型在多数任务上接近教师模型性能。

研究启发（模型推断）：人类移动性数据所蕴含的功能连接结构，可以作为地理空间基础模型的有效补充信号，提升模型对城市社会经济属性的预测能力，并具备跨城市泛化的潜力。

相关度：95/100 该研究直接针对地理空间基础模型（GFM）中人类活动信息缺失的问题，提出利用人类移动数据增强地理空间嵌入，与城市更新和时空数据挖掘的研究方向高度契合。
item.content:encoded:
中文标题：MoRAX：基于移动性的地理空间基础模型表示增强

作者：Ya Wen, Jixuan Cai, Yulun Zhou, Alec Kirkley

Abstract: Geospatial Foundation Models (GFMs) are emerging as a powerful paradigm for learning semantically rich and geographically consistent visual and physical representations. However, their reliance on Earth-observation (EO) data leaves information about human activity largely underrepresented. Human mobility data reveals the functional and relational structure between regions that is missing from EO data, but is often limited only to the city where it is observed, making it challenging to use for transferable urban representation learning. We introduce MoRAX, a lightweight framework for augmenting geospatial embeddings with functional structure derived from human mobility. MoRAX preserves the coverage and consistency of a GFM while providing information about the functional connectivity among urban regions, permitting zero-shot deployment in unseen cities with or without available mobility data. Across four target cities spanning two countries, the MoRAX teacher model, which observes mobility, consistently outperforms GFMs and strong urban representation baselines in eight socioeconomic and environmental prediction tasks. Meanwhile, the student model, which never takes mobility data as input, approaches the teacher in performance on most tasks. Transfer results across countries further demonstrate that modulation conditioned on mobility flows provides a general mechanism for grounding geospatial foundations in the human dimension of cities.

中文摘要：MoRAX是一个轻量级框架，通过人类移动性数据增强地理空间嵌入，以补充地球观测数据中缺失的人类活动功能结构信息。该框架在保留GFM覆盖范围和一致性的同时，提供城市区域间的功能连接信息，支持在未见过的城市中进行零样本部署。在四个目标城市的八项社会经济和环境预测任务中，观察移动性的教师模型持续优于GFM和强基线，而学生模型在多数任务上接近教师模型性能。

研究启发（模型推断）：人类移动性数据所蕴含的功能连接结构，可以作为地理空间基础模型的有效补充信号，提升模型对城市社会经济属性的预测能力，并具备跨城市泛化的潜力。

相关度：95/100 该研究直接针对地理空间基础模型（GFM）中人类活动信息缺失的问题，提出利用人类移动数据增强地理空间嵌入，与城市更新和时空数据挖掘的研究方向高度契合。

item.title: The Curious Case of Exploding DecPOMDPs: Containing the Fire through Policy Counting
item.description:
中文标题：爆炸性DecPOMDP的奇特案例：通过策略计数控制火势

作者：Nazl{\i} Nur Karabulut, Tanya Braun

Abstract: Decentralised partially observable Markov decision processes (DecPOMDPs) provide a general framework for modelling multi-agent decision making under uncertainty. However, DecPOMDPs are known to suffer from exponential complexity in the number of agents. One way to combat this intractability in agent numbers is to look at partitions of agents that exhibit a form of symmetry among agents, allowing for a compact encoding by counting. However, a challenge arises as the policy space explodes, even though the model complexity and evaluation cost reduce to a polynomial dependence. In this paper, we redirect our focus from counting agents to counting policies, which actually enables tractability in agent numbers for so called policy-counted DecPOMDPs. Further, we present policy-counted dynamic programming using the compact representation to solve policy-counted DecPOMDPs efficiently.

中文摘要：本文针对DecPOMDP中智能体数量指数级复杂性问题，提出从计数智能体转向计数策略，实现策略计数的DecPOMDP，并设计策略计数动态规划算法，利用紧凑表示高效求解。

研究启发（模型推断）：通过计数策略而非智能体，可在保持模型紧凑性的同时实现多智能体决策的可扩展性，为大规模地理空间多智能体规划提供了新思路。

相关度：70/100 该论文研究DecPOMDP中通过策略计数实现多智能体决策的可扩展性，与多智能体强化学习和分布式决策相关，对地理空间多智能体建模有理论价值。

item.title: Offline Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning with a Physics-Informed World Model for Cooperative Mixed Traffic Control
item.description:
中文标题：基于物理信息世界模型的离线多智能体强化学习用于合作混合交通控制

作者：Lu Liu, Chi Xie, Xi Xiong

Abstract: This study investigates cooperative control of connected and automated vehicles (CAVs) at partially observable highway bottlenecks in mixed traffic, aiming to mitigate congestion without relying on complete global traffic states or online trial-and-error. We propose a physics-informed world model-based offline multi-agent reinforcement learning framework that reconstructs a physically interpretable global traffic state from local CAV observation-action histories, with coupled macroscopic-microscopic traffic dynamics providing physics-based supervision. A probabilistic ensemble world model learns traffic-state transitions and system rewards, while model disagreement quantifies epistemic uncertainty. Multi-step imagined rollouts with pessimistic rewards and uncertainty-driven truncation are then used for offline policy learning. Experiments in a SUMO-based on-ramp bottleneck using approximately $1\times10^6$ offline transitions show that physics supervision improves state reconstruction and world-model prediction accuracy.

中文摘要：本文提出一种物理信息世界模型驱动的离线多智能体强化学习框架，用于部分可观测高速公路瓶颈处的CAV合作控制。通过耦合宏观-微观交通动力学提供物理监督，重建全局交通状态，并利用概率集成世界模型进行多步想象 rollout 和悲观奖励的离线策略学习。在SUMO仿真中，物理监督提升了状态重建和世界模型预测精度。

研究启发（模型推断）：物理信息监督可显著提升世界模型的状态重建能力，这为离线多智能体强化学习在真实交通控制中的应用提供了可行路径。

相关度：85/100 该论文研究混合交通中CAV的离线多智能体强化学习，结合物理信息世界模型，与GIS中的交通流模拟、智能交通系统及多智能体控制高度相关。

item.title: General Semantic Knowledge Infusion for Spatio-Temporal Traffic Forecasting
item.description:
中文标题：面向时空交通预测的通用语义知识注入

作者：Mattis thor Straten, Yannick Wolker, Steffen Strohm, Prathvish Mithare, Ralf Krestel, Matthias Renz

Abstract: Although Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have made significant advances in spatio-temporal traffic forecasting, their performance is limited when they rely solely on sensor proximity or road-network topology. This paper presents a spatio-temporal prediction framework, developed to incorporate knowledge in various forms. This framework aims to improve sensor-level, contextual understanding of the environment. A general-purpose knowledge graph (e.g., Wikidata) is used to create semantic subgraphs around traffic sensors and generate knowledge graph embeddings that capture meaningful relationships, such as nearby points of interest, administrative hierarchies, and the functional roles of locations. These embeddings are then fused with conventional traffic sensor graphs to provide additional adjacency matrices informed by semantics. This allows GNNs to learn the semantic context beyond physical connectivity. This study differs from previous research in two key ways. Firstly, rather than proposing a novel GNN architecture, it demonstrates the general impact of external knowledge on prediction accuracy. Secondly, experiments with well-established traffic forecasting approaches show that external knowledge provides additional information that street network data alone cannot convey. The results show that integrating data from general-purpose knowledge graphs and sensor networks through data fusion can enhance the prediction accuracy of traffic forecasting models, and offers a potential pathway toward improved interpretability.

中文摘要：本文提出一个时空预测框架，将通用知识图谱（如Wikidata）生成的语义子图嵌入与传统的交通传感器图融合，为GNN提供超越物理连接性的语义上下文。实验表明，融合通用知识图谱和传感器网络数据能提升交通预测模型的准确性，并可能提高模型的可解释性。该研究不提出新的GNN架构，而是展示外部知识对预测精度的普遍影响。

研究启发（模型推断）：通用知识图谱提供的语义信息（如兴趣点、行政层级、位置功能）是街道网络数据无法传达的补充信号，通过数据融合可有效提升交通预测性能。

相关度：85/100 该研究将通用知识图谱（如Wikidata）的语义信息融入时空交通预测模型，通过数据融合增强GNN的上下文理解，与多源数据融合的研究方向紧密相关。

item.title: To Remove or Not to Remove Clouds: A Comparative Analysis and Fusion of Raw SAR and Synthetic NDWI for Overcast Water Segmentation
item.description:
中文标题：去除还是不去除云层：阴天水体分割中原始SAR与合成NDWI的比较与融合

作者：Saleh Sakib Ahmed, Sara Nowreen, M. Sohel Rahman

Abstract: Persistent clouds blind optical satellites during floods. While Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) penetrates clouds, its raw data is noisy and lacks clear contrast. To mitigate this, recent studies utilize deep learning models to translate SAR into cloud-free synthetic optical imagery for downstream tasks like water body segmentation. However, because raw SAR is the original source for both of these operations, a critical methodological dilemma arises: during complete overcast should segmentation models process the raw SAR directly, or rely on a translated synthetic Normalized Difference Water Index (NDWI) proxy? This study resolves the debate by demonstrating that synthetic NDWI yields better results, as the translation process acts as a powerful filter against radar noise. This raises a natural second question: what if we utilize both? Building on our findings, we introduce a Combined Framework that integrates both raw SAR and synthetic NDWI into a unified model. By fusing the sharp physical boundaries of raw SAR with the high contrast of synthetic NDWI, this hybrid approach consistently outperforms all standalone methods.

中文摘要：该研究比较了在完全阴天条件下，直接使用原始SAR数据与使用翻译后的合成NDWI进行水体分割的性能，发现合成NDWI效果更好，并进一步提出融合两者的框架，性能优于任何单一方法。

研究启发（模型推断）：将原始SAR的物理边界与合成光学指数的高对比度融合，可有效克服雷达噪声，为多云地区的城市洪涝监测提供了更稳健的技术路径。

相关度：95/100 该研究直接针对多云条件下遥感水体分割问题，融合SAR和合成光学指数，是遥感变化检测和多源数据融合的典型应用，与城市更新中的洪涝监测高度相关。

item.title: Proactive Road Safety Intervention in Australia: Predicting Risky Driving Hotspots from Connected Vehicle Data
item.description:
中文标题：澳大利亚主动式道路安全干预：基于车联网数据预测危险驾驶热点

作者：Adriana-Simona Mih\u{a}i\c{t}\u{a}, Clarence Cheung, Artur Grigorev, Tuo Mao, David Lillo-Trynes

Abstract: Road safety monitoring has historically been reactive, relying on crash-record analysis after fatalities and injuries have already occurred. Proactive identification of high-risk locations and dangerous driving behaviour before incidents occur is a critical but underexplored challenge. This paper addresses this gap using connected vehicle telemetry data from Greater Sydney, Australia, to detect and forecast near-miss risky driving events at the Local Government Area (LGA) level. Risky driving is quantified through g-force thresholds (hard braking >0.6g, harsh cornering >0.47g, harsh acceleration >0.5g), and spatio-temporal heatmaps are constructed to identify high-risk zones. Eight predictive models are benchmarked across three families: ensemble learning (Random Forests, XGBoost, LightGBM), deep learning (LSTM, N-BEATS), and classical time-series methods (ARIMA, Exponential Smoothing, Prophet). ARIMA achieves the lowest mean absolute error (MAE: 162.21), performing comparably to LSTM (MAE: 163.92) and outperforming all ensemble methods, with N-BEATS reaching an MAE of 180.75. These results demonstrate that parsimonious time-series models are competitive with deep learning approaches when training data volume is limited. The study highlights the potential of IoT-based connected vehicle data to support proactive road safety interventions, with Sydney's inner and western LGAs (CBD, Parramatta, Bankstown) identified as persistent high-risk zones warranting targeted policy action.

中文摘要：该研究利用澳大利亚大悉尼地区的车联网遥测数据，通过g力阈值识别危险驾驶事件，构建时空热力图，并对比了集成学习、深度学习和经典时间序列模型在地方政府区域级别的预测性能。结果显示ARIMA模型表现最佳，与LSTM相当，优于集成方法。

研究启发（模型推断）：在数据量有限的情况下，简约的时间序列模型在预测城市级风险事件方面可与深度学习模型竞争，提示在城市更新规划中可优先考虑可解释性强的基线模型。

相关度：85/100 该研究利用车联网遥测数据预测高风险驾驶热点，属于城市尺度时空数据挖掘与预测，与城市更新中的安全监测和智能决策高度相关。

item.title: MoRA: Mobility as the Backbone for Geospatial Representation Learning at Scale
item.description:
中文标题：MoRA：以移动性为骨干的大规模地理空间表示学习

作者：Ya Wen, Jixuan Cai, Qiyao Ma, Linyan Li, Xinhua Chen, Chris Webster, Yulun Zhou

Abstract: ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

中文摘要：该论文摘要内容不完整，但根据标题推断，其核心思想是将人类移动性数据作为地理空间表示学习的主要数据源，旨在大规模地学习城市功能结构等地理空间特征。

研究启发（模型推断）：移动性数据有望成为地理空间基础模型的核心数据模态之一，用于学习反映城市功能与人类活动的空间表示。

相关度：90/100 该研究以移动性数据作为地理空间表示学习的主干，与城市更新和时空数据挖掘方向高度相关，且与MoRAX研究形成互补。

item.title: Exploring Efficient Open-Vocabulary Segmentation in the Remote Sensing
item.description:
中文标题：探索遥感中的高效开放词汇分割

作者：Bingyu Li, Haocheng Dong, Da Zhang, Zhiyuan Zhao, Junyu Gao, Xuelong Li

Abstract: ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

中文摘要：该研究探讨了遥感影像中开放词汇分割的高效方法，旨在利用视觉-语言模型实现对未见类别的分割，提升遥感影像分析的泛化能力。

研究启发（模型推断）：开放词汇分割有望减少对标注数据的依赖，提高遥感影像分析模型在动态城市环境中的适应性和可扩展性。

相关度：90/100 该研究聚焦遥感领域的开放词汇分割，是遥感影像智能解译的前沿方向，与遥感变化检测和地理空间智能高度相关。
